session_summary: Played as the Explorer & Collector persona, starting on the Gloomwood Hollow route. Completed the route, successfully defeated a goblin, cleared obstacles, collected 25 coins, and spent 45 coins in the marketplace to purchase and equip the Trail Cap cosmetic.

observations.evidence: Completed Gloomwood Hollow and received standard completion coins, but found no visible tracking or ledger for unique collectibles like Gloomcap or Root Relic.
observations.recommendation: Implement the planned Route Discovery Ledger and Collection Milestones UI to give collectors a satisfying way to track their discovered items across routes.

observations.evidence: Successfully purchased and equipped the 'trail_cap' cosmetic after finishing Gloomwood Hollow, ending with 88 coins.
observations.recommendation: Keep expanding the cosmetic catalog with hats and trails tied to specific route completion achievements.

observations.evidence: Route completion rewards are functional (+25 coins), but there are limited specific incentives or hidden secrets driving repeated revisits to already-completed routes.
observations.recommendation: Add route mastery levels, secret collectible variants, or time-trial goals to encourage players to replay routes.

feature_requests.title: Route Discovery Ledger and Collection Milestones UI
feature_requests.player_value: Allows collectors to track regional collectibles, hidden items, and completion percentages for every route.
feature_requests.rationale: As an Explorer & Collector, having a dedicated ledger provides clear long-term goals beyond basic currency accumulation.
feature_requests.desired_outcome: An in-game UI tab displaying collected route items and milestones.

feature_requests.title: Route-Specific Secret Collectibles and Cosmetic Unlocks
feature_requests.player_value: Gives players strong reasons to revisit previously completed routes to hunt down rare drops.
feature_requests.rationale: Revisiting routes currently lacks specialized discovery mechanics once standard completion rewards are claimed.
feature_requests.desired_outcome: Introduce rare hidden pick-ups on existing routes that unlock themed accessories or vanity tints.

keep: Rewarding route completion with consistent coin payouts that enable early marketplace purchases like the Trail Cap.
Diverse route thematic designs (e.g., Gloomwood Hollow, Ember Forge, Moon Shrine) that make exploration visually distinct.
Clear marketplace transaction feedback showing item purchases and remaining coin balances.
focus: route variety, discoveries, collectibles, cosmetics, reasons to revisit routes
